claim: The complete sample never reads, changes, or creates a real room
where: Demo banner, demo page, and README
sandbox: Seed an unrelated real session, enter the sample from the landing page, finish five turns, and assert no room-service request or real-key change.

claim: The landing page makes no third-party tracking request
where: First-screen facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: Record every request from a fresh landing-page load and assert all hosts are the product origin.

claim: Real play contacts only Roomcode Tactics and its room service
sandbox: Create a real test room while recording requests and assert only the client and product-owned room-service origins are contacted.

claim: Resetting the sample starts it again
sandbox: Resolve one sample turn, reset, then observe turn 1 again.

claim: Settings stay in this browser
sandbox: Enable still resolution effects in /demo, reload, and observe the checked setting.

claim: All four board focus keys can be remapped and stay in this browser
sandbox: In the sample, prove all four arrow keys move board focus, remap Left/Up/Right/Down to A/W/D/S, prove each new key works while its arrow no longer moves focus, then reload and observe every saved binding.

claim: Reloading reconnects to your saved room
sandbox: Create a room, reload the same browser context, and observe the same saved room.

claim: Copy room link writes the exact private room URL to the clipboard
sandbox: Create a real test room with clipboard permission, copy its link, read the clipboard, and compare it with the full room URL.

claim: Forget this room removes its browser entry without deleting the shared room early
sandbox: Create a real test room, forget it, assert its local entry is gone, then use the captured pass to confirm the shared room still responds.

claim: The browser removes expired room entries on the next visit
sandbox: Seed an expired browser room entry, reload, and assert the entry is removed.

claim: Two people create and join a room without an account or payment
sandbox: Two independent browser contexts create and join a room with names only.

claim: A room has two seats
sandbox: Fill both seats, then assert a third client receives a large, visible room-full recovery message.

claim: Rooms expire after 24 hours, then the service deletes their room, move, and pass-hash rows
where: Room flow, privacy page, terms, and README
sandbox: Assert the default expiry is 24 hours, use a shortened retention clock, and inspect SQLite after automatic cleanup.

claim: A match ends after five simultaneous turns
where: First-screen facts, game instructions, and README
sandbox: Two independent browser contexts submit five rounds and observe the winner end screen.

claim: Create another room leaves a completed real match at a fresh room form
sandbox: Complete five turns with two independent browser contexts, use the winner's restart action, and observe an empty room form and board preview.

claim: The page footer shows the current checked-out version
where: Terms page and every page footer
sandbox: Open the terms route and compare the rendered footer build with the exact short Git revision used by the running app.

claim: The sample and generated room maps use a seven-by-seven board
sandbox: Open the sample and create three real rooms, then assert each labelled board has 49 cells in seven columns.

claim: New rooms show a repeatable seed, cycle through difficulty 1–5, and rotate weather and marker value rules
where: Real board, README, and design notes
sandbox: Create ten rooms, assert two full 1–5 difficulty cycles and distinct seeds, cover Clear/Rain/Morning mist/Dry wind plus all-one/centre-two/outer-two marker values, reject a weather-closed adjacent trail for every closing weather, then restart the service and compare every saved map.

claim: Higher score wins after turn five; equal scores draw
sandbox: Two independent players hold position for five turns and observe a completed 0–0 draw.

claim: A five-turn match reaches its end screen in under 10 minutes of active play
sandbox: Two independent browser clients create, join, submit five rounds, and measure time to the winner end screen against a ten-minute limit.

claim: The room service saves an accepted move before replying and restores it after restart
sandbox: Submit a move, receive success, restart the service against the same SQLite files, and verify that move is still locked.

claim: Repeating the same move id does not submit a second move
sandbox: Repeat a saved move id and assert the saved result returns, while a different second move is rejected.

claim: New room passes are opaque and only their hashes are stored
sandbox: Create a room, inspect the pass format, use it, then verify SQLite contains only a different fixed-length hash.

claim: Repeated requests from one observed client receive 429 and Retry-After after the allowance
sandbox: Rotate caller-supplied forwarding values while keeping the ingress-observed address fixed and assert the allowance still returns 429 with Retry-After.

claim: Board resolution targets 60 fps and averages at least 55 fps in the tested mid-range phone profile
sandbox: Throttle the phone profile CPU by 4×, measure requestAnimationFrame delivery while resolving a sample turn, and assert at least 55 fps.
